normalize_features: normalize feature vectors by dividing each row by its L2 norm with epsilon regularization
load_input_data: load numpy feature arrays and target labels from .npy files and validate matching image counts
calculate_ap: compute average precision under the precision recall curve from recall and precision arrays
get_precision_recall: compute precision, recall, score arrays, and average precision from target labels and prediction scores
parse_cost_list: parse a comma-separated cost string and append 0.5 raised to powers 4 through 19
